# T-3: Add gate memory

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement bounded gate-impl prior memory using flow.json for behavior state and a spec-local artifact for detailed Observation history.

## Acceptance Criteria
- flow.json stores only the defined gateImplMemory index fields.
- The memory artifact stores the latest 3 gate-impl rounds with full Observation details.
- Prompt injection uses the memory artifact and never reads issue-log for behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse existing gate retry and similarity infrastructure, replacing `guardrail_id`/`reason` with `requirementRef`/`observed` for repeated FAIL comparison.

## Test Strategy
Unit/integration tests for memory writes, pruning to 3 rounds, prompt rendering, and issue-log audit-only separation.
